question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**example**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence structure indicates that the blank should introduce an instance or illustration supporting the previous statement.
 
• The phrase “For **example**, there were more than ten million Replika users…” fits naturally and meaningfully here. (उदाहरण के लिए)
 
• It correctly signals a specific case — the chatbot Replika — being presented as an example.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *For **example**__, there were more than ten million Replika users as of 2022.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Eligible** (योग्य): Refers to someone or something that is qualified or suitable, which doesn't suit the context of citing an instance.

 **Example:** He is eligible to vote at 18.
 
• **Entry** (प्रवेश): Refers to the act of entering, unrelated to citing a case or example.

 **Example:** His entry into the hall was dramatic.
 
• **Exit** (निर्गमन): Refers to the act of leaving or going out, not suitable as a sentence connector for providing an illustration.

 **Example:** The fire exit is at the back.
